title: Quick mode escalates to panel when the security trigger fires on a low-risk change
task: Validate client-supplied filenames in upload_path(filename) in uploads.py. Filenames arrive from HTTP clients; the server runs on POSIX. R1: raise ValueError when filename is empty, is . or .., or contains /, a backslash, or a NUL character. R2: otherwise return UPLOAD_DIR / filename unchanged. Risk: low; uploads land in a scratch directory that is wiped hourly.
